review.notes: AliStore POS is a point-of-sale app for electronics retail stores. A store cashier looks up catalog items, builds a sale, prepares split tender, receives a server-issued receipt, tracks shift status and reviews operation history. Access is role-based; a store provisions accounts for its own cashiers. App Review must receive an active demo cashier account with representative non-production review data.
review.appReviewNotes:
Paste this text into App Store Connect > App Review Information > Notes.

WHAT THE APP IS
AliStore POS is the point-of-sale app of a single electronics retail company in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan. A cashier employed by the company looks up catalog items, builds a sale, prepares split tender, receives a receipt issued by our server, follows the state of the shift and reviews the history of till operations. It is not a consumer app and is not usable without a cashier account issued by the company.

DEMO ACCOUNT
Access is role-based and accounts are provisioned from the company ERP back office — there is no self-service registration inside the app, by design. We have created a dedicated review cashier account and filled it in the Demo Account fields of this submission, with an open review shift and representative non-production catalog and sales data, so nothing done in review affects a live till. Sign in by entering the demo phone number, tapping Continue, and using the one-time code we supply — if it is not visible to you, request it through App Review Notes / Contact and we will relay the current one within minutes. If the demo account stops working during review, message us and we will re-issue it from the ERP immediately.

WHAT TO EXPECT
The full sale workflow is reviewable on the device alone. External receipt printers and payment terminals are optional certified hardware used in our stores; they are not needed to evaluate the software, and the app degrades to an on-screen receipt without them. Sales, shift open/close and every money movement are written to an append-only audit ledger scoped to the review store. The app does not track users and ships a privacy manifest declaring NSPrivacyTracking=false.

CONTACT
Support: https://ali.kg/support. We monitor App Review messages continuously during review.
